subtitle: Account Persistence & Unlock Intelligence
changes: Prepared secure Cloudflare Worker update to keep the private authenticated session active for the remaining Blizzard OAuth token lifetime, capped at 24 hours; requires separate owner deployment and never persists refresh tokens.
Extended the public site's separate server-validated verification receipt from 2 minutes to 15 minutes and explicitly states that local player progress is independent of account verification.
Added a read-only local progress overview and direct Sovereign Data Vault access inside the companion's My Azeroth section.

Prepared private My Azeroth Unlocks & Collections exploration for Blizzard-reported mounts, pets, toys, heirlooms and authorized character achievements; the private Worker upgrade must be deployed before these account features become available.

Existing equipped gear remains visible, but complete bag/bank inventory and live currency balances are not available from the Blizzard web API endpoints currently integrated; these are not fabricated.
Preserved all existing Warcraft studios, HYPER MUSIC, Founder avatar, saved builds and data formats. Live Cloudflare/browser/account validation remains pending.
